messages:
Theo Patel: FYI partner-cloud-eng on GCP marketplace just reported a throughput drop after their infra upgrade. They were on CUDA 12.2 + NVIDIA driver 535.x. Regression shows 15-20% slower tail latency.

Priya Nair: Oof. Do we have a repro config from them?

Theo Patel: They sent a minimal repro and perf traces. Attaching link: https://internal.s3/edge/regressions/2951234567

Samir Chen: first step: check driver/kernel ABI mismatch and cuBLAS/cutlass symbols. Ask them to run:
```
# on guest
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
python -c "import torch; print(torch.version.cuda)"
```

Claire Gomez: Also capture pmap and fw-binary diff. We saw similar noise when driver moved from 535.54 -> 535.86 (minor microcode change).

Theo Patel: Partner says their dedicated AMI bumped driver to 535.86 during marketplace sync. They were on 535.54 previously.

Priya Nair: Proposed mitigation: pin marketplace image to 535.54 and schedule hotfix AMI rebuild. Can we release a pinned AMI and flag 535.86 as 'investigate' in marketplace notes?

Samir Chen: +1. Also propose temporary runtime fallback in Redwood routing: route affected customers to 535.54-backed pools or to our quantized variant that bypasses offending kernel path.

Claire Gomez: We'll need partner signoff on rollback window. Ops SLA for marketplace deploys is 48 hours lead time for AMI rollbacks; can we expedite?

Theo Patel: Partner agrees to a 24h rollback window if we provide build and validation artifacts. I can own the partner comms.

deploy-bot: New incident ticket created: INC-2026-824 (link: https://redwood.atlassian/inc/INC-2026-824)

Priya Nair: Action items:
- Theo: coordinate rollback signoff + artifacts (eta 4h)
- Samir: create reproducible test container + perf harness (eta 6h)
- Claire: prepare AMI rebuild PR and smoke test matrix (eta 8h)
- Eng-oncall: stand by for hotpatch deployment window (24h)

Samir Chen: I'll also run cross-hardware sanity on ROCm variant to ensure we don't break AMD setups. Posting results to the link above when done.

Theo Patel: One more ask to partnerships: let's add an explicit driver pinning badge in the marketplace listing and a short 'known incompatibilities' note so partners aren't surprised.

Priya Nair: Agreed. I'll draft the marketplace copy and legal blurb for updates.

Claire Gomez: If rollback is blocked, fallback plan B: enable model-level quantized execution path (reduced perf but keeps throughput) and put customers into degraded mode with notice.

Samir Chen: I'll prepare a short runbook snippet we can paste into partner channel. Draft:

```
Runbook excerpt:
1) Verify driver matches pinned value: nvidia-smi
2) If mismatch, switch to pinned AMI: marketplace image v2026-05-pin-535.54
3) If rollback not possible, enable runtime fallback: REDWOOD_RUNTIME_MODE=compat-fallback
4) Collect /var/log/redwood/runtime.log and perf traces and attach to INC ticket
```

Theo Patel: Perfect. Let's sync after the artifacts are in — 3pm PT standup.

Priya Nair: :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Slack reminder set for 2026-06-15T15:00:00Z
